objective: Select the next measurement goal after the public benchmark pack externalization boundary was completed.
long_term_goal: Keep hybrid execution close to Verilator usage while making LLM-serving-like RTL workload correctness, speed trends, reproduction commands, and non-claims easy to regenerate and review.

options_reviewed.reason: The public pack now closes the persistent resident repeat-median evidence. The remaining serving-state gap is larger paged-attention/KV-cache behavior, which is closer to LLM serving than another MHA-only or runtime-only refinement.
options_reviewed.weakness: This can broaden workload-specific harness surface, so the first gate must be selection/measurement-boundary work and must avoid importing unreviewed candidate overlays as source of truth.

options_reviewed.reason: Fresh full ITA/MHA generic-host-probe evidence already covers 1x1, 32x1, and 1x32, while older MHA repeat-median and resident evidence already document the state-parallel versus repeated-step trend.
options_reviewed.weakness: More MHA shapes improve coverage breadth but do not add KV-cache or paged-attention serving-state behavior.

options_reviewed.reason: Prefill/decode split is already represented for the current MHA path. It becomes more valuable after selecting a richer paged-attention/KV-cache serving-state workload.
options_reviewed.weakness: Would mostly refine an already documented execution-shape distinction.

options_reviewed.reason: Resident, state-reuse, persistent-resident, and repeat-median evidence are now recorded and packaged. Further runtime optimization should follow a richer serving-state target.
options_reviewed.weakness: Can become runtime-centric and delay the next workload-representativeness step.

options_reviewed.reason: Quantized KV-cache is important but should follow a cleaner paged-attention/KV-cache scale-up boundary so quantization does not mix with scale-up, paging, and correctness semantics in one gate.
options_reviewed.weakness: Deferring leaves quantized serving memory behavior outside the next measurement.

selected_next_goal.name: paged_attention_kv_cache_scale_up
selected_next_goal.first_gate_objective: Define a scoped paged-attention/KV-cache scale-up measurement boundary using existing tracked templates and coverage-output equivalence before running or importing additional candidate overlays.
scope: start from tracked paged-attention KV-score and paged KV-cache evidence
prefer existing tracked templates before adding new overlays
preserve coverage_output_equivalence as the correctness policy
keep generated reports and artifacts non-canonical
do not claim production paged attention, production KV-cache hierarchy, or model-level Transformer inference

non_claims: not a runtime or ABI change
not broad speedup for arbitrary RTL
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
